profile: Portable example AliExpress US / Walmart listing policy
applicability: Example only; each operator supplies their own account, brand, shipping and pricing evidence.

selectionPolicy.appliesTo: New selections and new creative production; preserve completed prior work
selectionPolicy.markupBasis: Repeatable procurement landed cost to US plus 15 USD sets retail price; platform and other selling costs are then deducted. Confirmed 2026-10-14.

pricingStrategy.method: Adaptive cost / comparable competition / modeled demand pricing
pricingStrategy.legacyMarkupRole: 15 USD markup retained as comparison, superseded as universal pricing standard by the subsequent request for a pricing curve
pricingStrategy.optimizationObjective: Expected total variable contribution within profit floor and comparable market cap
pricingStrategy.demandCalibrationStatus: No real price-conversion data fitted; model launch prices only
pricingStrategy.illustrativeParametersStatus: Analyst proposals, not confirmed user goals or empirical estimates

selectionPolicy.minimumTargetsStatus: Not specified by user; any suggested 5 USD / 20 percent threshold is an analyst proposal

variantPolicy: First verified default variant, then lock explicitly across reloads
visualDirection: Strong product-led tension, physical action and spatial typography, preserving the selected SKU
automaticContinuation: Only when requested; this batch was left for manual continuation
